column1: # Library titles on the children's shelf.
# Columns, separated by a single tab: the start of a ZIM file name, then a note.
# "vikidia_en_all" covers vikidia_en_all_maxi and vikidia_en_all_nopic. A title
# is on the shelf only if it is listed here or in /etc/offline/children.local.tsv,
# which upgrades never overwrite; everything else is for adults who have signed in.
# These were chosen because each is made for children or for the classroom.
# Wikipedia in simple English is not listed: it is written simply, but it covers
# every subject the full encyclopaedia does. Add "wikipedia_en-simple_all" to the
# local file if that suits your household.
